description: Dept. of Trade and Investment Policy - Duties of Customs leviable on goods & exemptions, under the Custom Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory power under the Customs Ordinance to grant duty exemptions. It constitutes a statutory instrument (an Order) that modifies the application of existing customs laws for specific importers and goods, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (new regulations, statutory instruments, and regulatory frameworks). While a government minister is named, the core content is about regulatory action, not about the minister's appointment, portfolio responsibilities, or government structure.
